name: Massless Particle System
definition: Particles are used as tracer elements to visualize flow, as droplets to model fire suppression, or as fuel elements (embers). Positions are determined by a differential equation assuming drag force is large compared to gravity.
summary: The Massless Particle System visualizes flow fields by advecting tracer particles through a pre-computed velocity field, distinguishing itself by ignoring inertia and gravity to prioritize computational efficiency.
